subject: Predictable p99 for a multi-region data layer
body:
Hi Tom,

The Northwind Payments team is focused on capacity planning and evaluating cost and latency improvements for its multi-region data layer. If tail latency is part of that evaluation, ScyllaDB may be worth a look. Its shard-per-core C++ architecture has no JVM garbage-collection pauses, which keeps p99 latency predictable under load.

subject: GC pauses and p99 on a Cassandra leaderboard
body:
Hi Lior,

Thanks for connecting. Your talk on running 60 self-managed Apache Cassandra nodes for the Kestrel Games leaderboard stuck with me, especially the tail latency and GC/compaction tuning side of it.
